# Test: grove remove --force --branch warns about commits on a branch without an upstream
setup_workspace

exec grove add --base main no-upstream
cd ../no-upstream
cp $WORK/local.txt local.txt
exec git add local.txt
exec git commit -m 'local commit'
cd ../main

exec grove remove --force --branch no-upstream
stderr 'no-upstream: 1 commit.*will be lost'
stderr 'Removed worktree.*no-upstream'
stderr 'deleted branch'
! exists ../no-upstream
assert_branch deleted no-upstream

-- local.txt --
local only
